description: Header file declaring utility functions, macros, and constants for WAN management, including application control, system info retrieval, and feature-specific APIs.

methods.name: WanManager_DoStartApp
methods.description: Starts an application with given name and command line arguments.

methods.name: WanManager_DoRestartApp
methods.description: Restarts an application with specified name and arguments.

methods.name: WanManager_DoStopApp
methods.description: Stops the specified application.

methods.name: WanManager_DoCollectApp
methods.description: Cleans zombie processes for the specified application.

methods.name: WanManager_DoSystemAction
methods.description: Executes a system command from a caller.

methods.name: WanManager_DoSystemActionWithStatus
methods.description: Executes a system command and returns its status.

methods.name: CollectApp
methods.description: Collects zombie processes by PID.

methods.name: WanManager_StartIpoeHealthCheckService
methods.description: Starts the IPoE health check service, returns PID or 0.

methods.name: WanManager_StopIpoeHealthCheckService
methods.description: Stops the IPoE health check service.

methods.name: GetPathToApp
methods.description: Finds the path of a specified application.

methods.name: WanManager_GetDateAndUptime
methods.description: Retrieves current date and system uptime.

methods.name: WanManager_getUpTime
methods.description: Returns system uptime in seconds.

methods.name: util_spawnProcess
methods.description: Spawns a new process.

methods.name: util_terminateProcessForcefully
methods.description: Forcefully terminates a process by PID.

methods.name: util_signalProcess
methods.description: Sends a signal to a process.

methods.name: util_getPidByName
methods.description: Gets PID of a process by name.

methods.name: util_getNameByPid
methods.description: Gets process name by PID.

methods.name: util_collectProcess
methods.description: Collects a process with timeout.

methods.name: util_runCommandInShellBlocking
methods.description: Runs a shell command blocking until completion.

methods.name: WanManager_Util_GetShell_output
methods.description: Reads output from a shell command.

methods.name: WanMgr_SetRestartWanInfo
methods.description: Sets restart info for WAN.

methods.name: WanMgr_RestartUpdateCfg
methods.description: Updates configuration and restarts as needed.

methods.name: WanMgr_RestartUpdateCfg_Bool
methods.description: Updates boolean configuration and restarts as needed.

methods.name: sysctl_iface_set
methods.description: Sets interface parameters via sysctl.
